description: Massively multilingual zero-shot TTS model from k2-fsa for 600+ languages, supporting short-reference voice cloning, attribute-based voice design, pronunciation controls, and nonverbal tags.

request.name: seed
request.description: Generation seed; omitted requests choose a random seed.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: Iterative masked-decoding steps; fewer is faster.

request.name: speed
request.description: Speech speed multiplier; ignored when duration is set.

request.name: duration
request.description: Target output duration in seconds; overrides speed. Omitted requests estimate it from the text.

request.name: t_shift
request.description: Shift of the unmasking schedule across decoding steps.

request.name: denoise
request.description: Add the denoise token to the prompt when cloning from reference audio.

request.name: preprocess_prompt
request.description: Remove silence from the reference audio and punctuate the reference text.

request.name: postprocess_output
request.description: Remove long silences from the generated audio and trim its edges.

request.name: layer_penalty_factor
request.description: Score penalty per codebook layer when choosing positions to unmask; favours lower layers.

request.name: position_temperature
request.description: Sampling temperature for choosing positions to unmask.

request.name: class_temperature
request.description: Sampling temperature for token classes; 0 is greedy.

request.name: audio_chunk_duration
request.description: Target audio seconds per chunk when long text is split automatically.

request.name: audio_chunk_threshold
request.description: Estimated output seconds above which long text is split automatically.

request.name: text_chunk_size
request.description: Framework text chunk size in codepoints; when set, replaces the automatic split.

request.name: text_chunk_mode
request.description: Framework text chunking mode, used when text_chunk_size is set.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: Transcript of the speaker reference audio; required when reference audio is given.

request.name: instruction
request.description: Voice-design instruction such as speaker attributes; without reference audio it selects voice design.

session.name: mem_saver
session.description: Release staged runtime graphs after request phases.

session.name: perf_mode
session.description: Generator performance mode; off keeps the exact-safe attention path. flash_attention cannot be combined with mem_saver.

session.name: generator_weight_type
session.description: Generator weight storage type; overrides weight_type.

session.name: audio_tokenizer_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Audio tokenizer graph arena size in MB.

session.name: generator_prefill_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Generator prefill graph arena size in MB.

session.name: generator_decode_graph_arena_mb
session.description: Generator decode graph arena size in MB.

session.name: audio_tokenizer_weight_context_mb
session.description: Audio tokenizer weight context size in MB.

session.name: generator_weight_context_mb
session.description: Generator weight context size in MB.

packages.description: Egyptian Arabic and Arabic-English code-switching fine-tune of OmniVoice from mohammedaly22/VoiceTut-TTS (same architecture and audio tokenizer as OmniVoice). Use language=arz.
